# Vendor

## Cactus-Compute/whistle

1. put [`libneedle.a`](https://huggingface.co/Cactus-Compute/needle3/tree/main/macos-arm64) file under `vendor/cactus/libneedle.a`
2. run the cargo build script
3. [`whistle.cact`](https://huggingface.co/Cactus-Compute/whistle/blob/main/whistle.cact) should be placed under `~/.vox/models/multilingual_tiny/whistle.cact`
